patterns.title: Scoped agent tool loop
patterns.proposal: Separate planning, permission checks, tool execution and observation; bounded turns and budgets.
patterns.acceptance: A synthetic run denies an unauthorized write and stops after its budget; valid actions retain input/output evidence.
patterns.stop_condition: No arbitrary hook or shell execution; do not grant broad credentials.

patterns.title: Durable task ledger and lease
patterns.proposal: Record claim, owner, scope, lease, progress, evidence and handoff in persistent state.
patterns.acceptance: Two workers contend for one task; one wins; expired lease is recoverable without duplicate side effects.
patterns.stop_condition: No shared uncommitted edits or assumed exactly-once delivery.

patterns.title: Checkpoint, resume and idempotency
patterns.proposal: Persist input fingerprints and completion boundaries; retry only safe operations.
patterns.acceptance: Inject interruption after write and before acknowledgement; restart yields one durable result.
patterns.stop_condition: Never repeat irreversible submission or external payment automatically.

patterns.title: Comparable offline model evaluation
patterns.proposal: Use versioned cases, expected evidence, deterministic checks, judge rubric, latency and cost.
patterns.acceptance: Run identical fixture set twice; score exact cases deterministically and report sample size, missing outcomes and cost.
patterns.stop_condition: LLM judge is advisory; no estimated success probability presented as calibrated.

patterns.title: Shadow, canary and rollback for routing
patterns.proposal: Evaluate candidate routing on recorded tasks before promotion; compare against frozen baseline.
patterns.acceptance: A synthetic quality regression blocks promotion even if cost improves; rollback restores previous policy.
patterns.stop_condition: No silent model updates or live rollout based on small samples.

patterns.title: Evidence-linked document retrieval
patterns.proposal: Index immutable document chunks with page, source revision and section IDs; return citations with answers.
patterns.acceptance: A synthetic tender with conflicting addenda returns both passages and flags the unresolved requirement.
patterns.stop_condition: Retrieval ranking is not authority; never discard conflicting or superseded evidence.

patterns.title: Hybrid lexical and semantic search
patterns.proposal: Compare exact keyword, semantic and hybrid search; filter by metadata and preserve stable source IDs.
patterns.acceptance: A labeled query set measures recall@k and latency for each method; rare drawing numbers remain retrievable.
patterns.stop_condition: Start with simple indexed search; no vector database until measurable benefit.

patterns.title: Stable records and transactional audit
patterns.proposal: Separate immutable input events from current derived state; enforce unique IDs and replay rules.
patterns.acceptance: Replay duplicate and out-of-order events; final state is identical with audit entries intact.
patterns.stop_condition: No destructive overwrite or unreviewed schema migration.

patterns.title: Shared object identity across 2D and 3D
patterns.proposal: Give each engineering object one stable ID and coordinate reference; selection maps to plan, section and 3D.
patterns.acceptance: Select synthetic object in all views; ID, units and numeric quantity agree with authoritative fixture.
patterns.stop_condition: Rendering is downstream of calculations; no quantities inferred from pixels.

patterns.title: Projection and clipping reference cases
patterns.proposal: Test world-to-view transforms, unit conversion, clipping and section intersection on known geometry.
patterns.acceptance: Known cube and sloped surface match analytic section and coordinate outputs within documented tolerance.
patterns.stop_condition: A renderer is not a civil volume engine; do not replace a verified solver.

patterns.title: Native readback with independent reconciliation
patterns.proposal: Place native measurements from verified geometry; read back tool-computed values and compare against independent references.
patterns.acceptance: Synthetic mismatch produces CHECK with both values; no automated APPROVED transition.
patterns.stop_condition: Never alter signed originals or average disagreements to force agreement.

patterns.title: 4D planned versus observed progress
patterns.proposal: Keep dated planned state, observed evidence and unknown state distinct; map them to stable element IDs.
patterns.acceptance: Missing observation stays unknown and cannot advance installed quantity or payment status.
patterns.stop_condition: Photo labels and rendered views are not certified installed progress.

patterns.title: Local regression and independent review gate
patterns.proposal: Record baseline, failing case, targeted fix, regression commands, commit and fresh-context review.
patterns.acceptance: A known failing fixture blocks release; unavailable environment yields NOT_RUN rather than PASS.
patterns.stop_condition: No GitHub Actions or new paid service; use existing target-project scripts first.

patterns.title: Isolated branch/worktree coordination
patterns.proposal: Claim file scope and base SHA, isolate changes, inspect diff and reconcile before merge.
patterns.acceptance: Parallel workers editing the same module detect collision and stop; no force-push.
patterns.stop_condition: Never merge changed head without rechecking; respect repository-specific rules.

patterns.title: Least privilege and untrusted-input boundary
patterns.proposal: Treat document instructions, tool results and upstream code as untrusted data; use allowlists and explicit authorization.
patterns.acceptance: Synthetic prompt injection cannot expand file access, expose a secret or trigger a write.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not install skills, execute scripts, or transfer real documents during research.

patterns.title: Deterministic core with advisory AI
patterns.proposal: Keep calculations, rules and state transitions separate from AI explanations; surface evidence and override rationale.
patterns.acceptance: A contradictory AI suggestion cannot change deterministic results or approve actions.
patterns.stop_condition: Human ownership of bid submission and estimate approval remains explicit.

patterns.title: Local-first recoverable workflow
patterns.proposal: Persist valid last-known state; mark stale, offline and error states; retry without data loss.
patterns.acceptance: Offline reload and failed refresh preserve last-known data and visible timestamp.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not confuse cached or fictional data with live results.

patterns.title: Explainable recommendation and feedback
patterns.proposal: Separate rule-based ranking from explanations; record outcomes without collecting unnecessary raw data.
patterns.acceptance: Synthetic feedback improves a later comparison without changing historic score evidence.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not conflate user preference, predicted fit and empirical success.

patterns.title: Accessibility and UI acceptance evidence
patterns.proposal: Apply existing design library checks to keyboard, 320px layout, reduced motion and error states.
patterns.acceptance: Real target browser demonstrates keyboard operation and readable layout; if unavailable, mark NOT_RUN.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not relabel isolated component testing as production browser sign-off.

patterns.title: Schema migration and recovery
patterns.proposal: Version persisted schemas; validate before replacing saved state; retain a backup on migration failure.
patterns.acceptance: Synthetic old, current and corrupt states exercise migration, read-only fallback and repeatable recovery.
patterns.stop_condition: Never silently discard valid records or overwrite the original on a failed migration.

patterns.title: Append-only event replay with deduplication
patterns.proposal: Separate event identity, cursor and processing result; detect repeated or late events.
patterns.acceptance: Replaying a duplicate event and a crash after processing does not duplicate the derived record.
patterns.stop_condition: No promise of exactly-once effects across external systems.

patterns.title: Content-addressed artifacts and reproducible manifests
patterns.proposal: Bind evidence to content digest, revision, method and recorded environment, not mutable filenames.
patterns.acceptance: One-byte artifact change and missing manifest entry cause verification failure; originals remain untouched.
patterns.stop_condition: Hash proves identity, not semantic accuracy or permission.

patterns.title: Exact-token indexing and ranking baseline
patterns.proposal: Start with deterministic lexical indexing, normalization and transparent ranking; compare with semantic retrieval only if useful.
patterns.acceptance: Labeled fixture retains exact drawing IDs and aliases, ranks known relevant records and measures recall.
patterns.stop_condition: Never silently infer source authority or suppress rare identifiers.

patterns.title: Scriptable CLI with dry-run contract
patterns.proposal: Expose explicit input, output, preview and machine-readable exit codes; make destructive actions opt-in.
patterns.acceptance: Dry-run leaves filesystem unchanged; malformed input returns a documented nonzero status.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not add command execution permissions or run third-party code by default.

patterns.title: Versioned prompt and inference configuration
patterns.proposal: Record model/configuration, prompt template revision, dataset and judge revision with outputs.
patterns.acceptance: Changing inference settings yields a distinct run identity; missing settings mark comparison incomplete.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not conflate tutorial models with production model capabilities or train without approval.

patterns.title: Document revision lineage and supersession
patterns.proposal: Represent revision ancestry and explicit replacement/supersession relations separately from text similarity.
patterns.acceptance: Cumulative addendum fixture retains unique requirements and flags ambiguous conflicting changes.
patterns.stop_condition: No last-write-wins rule or auto-resolved contractual contradiction.

patterns.title: Dependency and capability manifest
patterns.proposal: Record dependency version, origin, license, network/filesystem capabilities and reason before enabling a feature.
patterns.acceptance: Unapproved dependency, unsafe lifecycle hook or unknown license is reported and blocks promotion.
patterns.stop_condition: Do not mistake a repository license for all assets or transitive licenses.

patterns.title: Unit, datum and tolerance contracts
patterns.proposal: Require declared unit, scale, coordinate system and tolerance at calculation boundaries.
patterns.acceptance: Synthetic scale and datum mismatch fails closed; accepted case matches independent analytic fixture.
patterns.stop_condition: Never convert unknown units or replace a verified engineering solver.

patterns.title: Adapter boundary for optional AI and offline mode
patterns.proposal: Keep deterministic domain functions callable without network or provider credentials; adapters report availability.
patterns.acceptance: Disabled or failing provider does not stop deterministic workflow or silently mark output live.
patterns.stop_condition: No unauthorized provider calls, credentials or data sharing.

patterns.title: Test evidence and release claim ledger
patterns.proposal: Associate each release claim with exact commit, command, evidence and verification status.
patterns.acceptance: Stale PASS and missing required evidence cannot produce a release-ready state.
patterns.stop_condition: No automatic release approval from passing checks.

patterns.title: Freshness and stale-decision invalidation
patterns.proposal: Bind decision to input identity/version and show freshness; require review when input changes.
patterns.acceptance: Changed fingerprint invalidates prior decision while unchanged input preserves audit history.
patterns.stop_condition: Never imply current source data or approval from a cached recommendation.
